data.narrative:
Deterrence is a seed-stage defense and security company that has raised $10M+. The peer universe comprises 10 comparable companies across defense and security—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private—including Series A-stage peers Stark Defence ($4.0B), Singularity ($400M), NODA AI ($125M), and seed-stage UFORCE ($1.0B).

Two valuation methods were applied. The Stage-Progression method uses the $10M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical for seed-to-next-stage advancement, implying $25M. The Peer-Median method across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $700M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. The wide peer range reflects heterogeneous outcomes within the defense tech sector at similar stages.

Triangulating these two methods produces a low estimate of $21M, a median of $362M, and a high of $805M. The substantial gap between stage-progression and peer-median signals material uncertainty around Deterrence's competitive positioning relative to funded peers. Key uncertainties include product maturity, customer traction, and technology differentiation relative to the peer set. The peer-median approach carries elevated variance given the four-company sample size and the 32x spread between peer minimum and maximum valuations, suggesting caution in reliance on any single method.
